description: Retrieves the credit balance summary for a customer in Stripe Billing. This action returns the available and ledger balances for billing credits granted to a customer. You can filter by a specific credit grant, price type (metered), specific prices, or billable items. The balance summary includes one entry per currency used in the credit grants. Use Cases: - Check remaining billing credits for a customer - View credit balances for specific metered prices or products - Monitor available vs. ledger balance for billing credits - Track credit usage across different currencies

customer.description: The Stripe customer ID whose credit balance summary is being retrieved. Either 'customer' or 'customer_account' must be specified. Starts with 'cus_'.
customer.title: Customer

customer_account.description: The Stripe account ID representing the customer. Either 'customer' or 'customer_account' must be specified. Use this for multi-entity accounts.
customer_account.title: Customer Account

filter.description: Filtering criteria for the credit balance summary. Specify either 'credit_grant' to get balance for a specific grant, or 'applicability_scope' to filter by price type, specific prices, or billable items.

applicability_scope.description: Billing credit scope for fetching balance summary. Required when filter type is 'applicability_scope'.

billable_items.description: List of specific billable item IDs to filter the balance summary. Cannot be combined with 'price_type' or 'prices'.

id.description: The Stripe billable item ID. Must be a metered billable item.
id.title: Id

billable_items.title: Billable Items

price_type.description: Filter by price type. Use 'metered' to get balance summary for all metered prices. Cannot be combined with 'prices' or 'billable_items'.
price_type.title: Price Type

prices.description: List of specific metered price IDs to filter the balance summary. Cannot be combined with 'price_type' or 'billable_items'.

id.description: The Stripe price ID. Must be a metered price with an attached billing meter.
id.title: Id

prices.title: Prices

applicability_scope.title: ApplicabilityScope

credit_grant.description: The Stripe credit grant ID for which to fetch the balance summary. Required when filter type is 'credit_grant'. Starts with 'credgr_'.
credit_grant.title: Credit Grant

type.description: The type of filter to apply. Must be either 'applicability_scope' or 'credit_grant'.
type.title: Type

filter.title: Filter

name: get_billing_credit_balance_summary

custom_pricing_unit.description: Custom pricing unit balance details when type is 'custom_pricing_unit'.
custom_pricing_unit.title: Custom Pricing Unit

last_updated_at.description: Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) when the balance was last updated.
last_updated_at.title: Last Updated At

monetary.description: Monetary balance details when type is 'monetary'.
monetary.title: Monetary

type.description: The type of balance. Either 'monetary' for currency-based balance or 'custom_pricing_unit' for unit-based balance.
type.title: Type

available_balance.description: Credits ready for customer use, accounting for expired credits not yet processed.
available_balance.title: Available Balance

unit_name.description: Name of the custom pricing unit.
unit_name.title: Unit Name

balances.description: Collection of billing credit balances, with one entry per credit grant currency.
balances.title: Balances

customer.description: The customer identifier associated with the balance.
customer.title: Customer

customer_account.description: The account identifier for the balance.
customer_account.title: Customer Account

livemode.description: Indicates whether the object exists in live mode (true) or test mode (false).
livemode.title: Livemode

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'billing.credit_balance_summary'.
object.title: Object

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd').
currency.title: Currency

value.description: Positive integer amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents).
value.title: Value
